Read from source code or the constitution, or computed by stated arithmetic from source constants and measured counts. Names the file and symbol.
A stated modelling choice, or the output of the simulation under stated inputs. Names its parameters.
Extrapolated to planetary scale from certified lower tiers; always carries an interval. Nothing on this page is PROJECTED yet: no tier is certified.
Open: no source or measurement supports it yet. Names what is missing.
